verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit supports natural-language learnings/chat-taught preferences, path-specific instructions, AST-grep pattern-based rules, auto-detection of existing style guide files (.cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), and org-wide centralized YAML configuration — directly covering natural-language rules, AST patterns, and linked style guides as requested. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that custom rules are reliably enforced in practice (community evidence is mixed/general rather than specifically about rule adherence).
